description_expanded: SummaryEscape to Mississippi Magnolia, a charming beach cottage in Magnolia Cottages by the Sea, just minutes from the Gulf’s pristine white sands. Located in a quiet neighborhood, this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom retreat offers a cozy coastal atmosphere with a fully stocked kitchen, spacious living area, and private screened porch. Enjoy access to a shared pool, explore scenic 30A, or take a short stroll to the beach. Whether you’re here for adventure or relaxation, this home is your perfect getaway!SpaceGet ready for a spectacular coastal escape at "Mississippi Magnolia," a beautiful beach cottage nestled in the highly coveted Magnolia Cottages by the Sea, just a short stroll from the sugar-white sands and crystal-clear waters of 30A. Positioned perfectly between the chic Rosemary and Alys Beach to the East, and the lively hub of The Big Chill to the West, this home is at the heart of it all, offering the ultimate beachside retreat. Step inside to find a thoughtfully designed, coastal-inspired cottage featuring a spacious, fully equipped kitchen, 3 bedrooms, and 3 full bathrooms, ideal for accommodating up to 8 guests. Whether you're gathering for a family vacation, celebrating with friends, or sneaking away for a couples’ retreat, there's room for everyone to relax and recharge. Kick back on the private screened-in porch, where soft ocean breezes and lush greenery provide the perfect backdrop for sipping morning coffee or unwinding with evening cocktails. It’s your own little sanctuary for soaking in the calm and natural beauty of the area. The best part? The deeded beach access is just a short 3-5 minute walk from the front door, allowing for quick, easy access to some of the most stunning beaches the Emerald Coast has to offer. Spend your days basking in the sun, splashing in the waves, or taking leisurely strolls along the shoreline—it’s all just steps away. When you're ready for a dip but don’t feel like venturing far, head to the community pool for a refreshing swim right in your own neighborhood. Whether you’re seeking adventure or relaxation, “Mississippi Magnolia” has it all—unbeatable proximity to the beach, luxurious community amenities, and the charm of coastal living. Book your unforgettable getaway today and let the magic of 30A create memories that will last a lifetime! HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - Large heated (Winter months) resort style pool - Easy walk to beach access BEACH ACCESS/SERVICE: - There is deeded beach access directly across from the neighborhood. - In order to sit near the access, you must rent a "set" (2 chairs and an umbrella) otherwise you may use the access and walk less than 2 minutes to the right or 4 minutes to the left to the public access. - Beach Service is provided by a local vendor; information provided upon request SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 8) - Primary Suite - 1st floor: King bedroom, private bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo - Queen Bedroom - 1st floor: Queen bed, private bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo - Bunk Room - 1st floor: 4 twin bunks: Hall bath includes a shower FEATURES: - 3 Bedroom/3 Bathroom Cottage - Sleeps 8 - Private screened-in porches on each floor - Full Sized Washer Dryer - Fully Appointed Kitchen - Full Size Refrigerator - Full Size Oven/Stove - Charcoal grill - Complimentary Wifi - Large HEATED (Winter and at HOA's discretion) Community Pool only steps away - Parking for 2 cars in driveway (no street parking) - Close Proximity to the beach - neighborhood is directly across 30A from beach access - 18 Mile Bike Path along 30A - Close to The Big Chill, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach and Seaside NeighborhoodMagnolia Cottages by the Sea is a small, discreet neighborhood tucked away between Seagrove and Alys Beaches. It is close to everything, but still offers the comforts of a beach vacation coupled with a quiet getaway.AccessGuests can access all of the home and share access to the pool and deeded beach access.NotesA Note on Shared Amenities: Please keep in mind that these spaces are operated by the HOA. Because of this, they are subject to seasonal availability—common seasonal closures may include April-May and Sept-Nov—and we can't be held responsible for unexpected closures or repairs. If you are booking specifically for a shared amenity, please feel free to reach out with any questions in advance!House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are not allowed. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees to follow all local, state and federal level mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19. Violations that result in fines based on Guests' actions will be passed on to the Guest. 19. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 20. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 21. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted. Read Less
